8 days Golden Triangle tour with Varanasi

Delhi · Jaipur · Agra · Varanasi · 8 days

8 days Golden Triangle tour packages Private tour Licensed guide

Delhi, Jaipur and a full day in Agra, then the Vande Bharat east to the Ganga — the evening aarti, a sunrise boat and Sarnath — and a flight home.

At a glance

What makes this one worth it

  • Old and New Delhi with a rickshaw ride
  • Amber Fort and the Jaipur city palaces
  • A full day in Agra — Taj Mahal at sunrise, Agra Fort, the Baby Taj and Mehtab Bagh
  • Vande Bharat Express from Agra to Varanasi
  • Ganga aarti at Dashashwamedh Ghat and a sunrise boat on the river
  • Kashi Vishwanath, Sarnath and Banaras Hindu University

Your day by day

  1. Day 1

    Arrive in Delhi

    Our representative meets you and takes you to your hotel. Evening at leisure. Overnight in Delhi.

  2. Day 2

    Old and New Delhi

    A full day with your guide — Jama Masjid, a rickshaw ride through Chandni Chowk and the spice market, a photo stop outside the Red Fort, then Humayun's Tomb, India Gate, a drive past Parliament House, Qutub Minar and the Lotus Temple. Overnight in Delhi.

  3. Day 3

    Delhi to Jaipur

    Breakfast and about four hours to Jaipur. Check in and rest, then the City Palace and Patrika Gate in the evening. Overnight in Jaipur.

  4. Day 4

    Jaipur, then on to Agra

    Amber Fort, a photo stop at Jal Mahal, the Hawa Mahal and the Jantar Mantar, then about four hours to Agra. Overnight in Agra.

  5. Day 5

    A full day in Agra

    The Taj Mahal at sunrise, back for breakfast, then Agra Fort, Itimad-ud-Daulah — the Baby Taj — and sunset from Mehtab Bagh across the river. Overnight in Agra.

  6. Day 6

    Vande Bharat to Varanasi, the evening aarti

    An early transfer to the station for the 6 am Vande Bharat Express, arriving in Varanasi around 1:30 pm. Check in, then the Ganga aarti on the river bank in the evening. Overnight in Varanasi.

  7. Day 7

    Varanasi and Sarnath

    A boat along the ghats before sunrise, then Kashi Vishwanath Temple, Sarnath — where the Buddha first taught — the Durga temple, Banaras Hindu University and the old markets. Overnight in Varanasi.

  8. Day 8

    Fly back to Delhi

    Breakfast and transfer to Varanasi airport for the flight to Delhi. Timings can move around your onward flight.

Questions people ask

Is the Ganga Aarti included in the package?
Yes. You will watch the evening Ganga Aarti at Dashashwamedh Ghat as part of your Varanasi sightseeing, and an early morning boat ride on the Ganges is included as well.
Is hotel accommodation included?
Yes, 7 nights across Delhi, Jaipur, Agra and Varanasi in handpicked 3, 4 or 5-star hotels of your choice. If you would rather book your own rooms, we can also quote the tour without hotels.
How many days do I need for the Golden Triangle and Varanasi?
Eight days works well and gives each city enough time without rushing. If you prefer a gentler pace, we can stretch it to around 10 days with a few rest days.
What does the cost depend on?
The price on the page is per person for two people sharing, and it depends on group size, car and hotel category, as well as the class of train travel you choose. We confirm a fixed quote with you before you pay anything.
What time does the Varanasi morning boat ride happen?
The boat sets off early, usually before sunrise, so you can watch the ghats wake up as the sun rises over the river. The ride is included in your tour.
Is Sarnath included in the Varanasi sightseeing?
Yes. Sarnath, a short drive from the city and one of the most important Buddhist sites in the world, is part of your Varanasi sightseeing day.
Which days of the week affect the plan?
The Taj Mahal is closed on Fridays and the Lotus Temple on Mondays, while the Red Fort is a photo stop from outside anyway. We arrange your dates so each sight falls on an open day.
How much luggage can we bring on the train and flight?
The Vande Bharat chair car has overhead racks, so medium suitcases work better than very large ones. Domestic economy flights usually allow 15 kg checked baggage, and any excess is paid at the airport.
Can we add an extra night anywhere?
Yes. Many guests add a night in Varanasi or Jaipur for a slower pace, and we will send you a revised written itinerary and price before you confirm.
